scope: Actual browser AudioWorklet buffered streaming API and captured output PCM from context-rate synthetic stereo. No production AudioEngine integration, ordinary scratch, native app/hardware, long-file memory or vendor equivalence proof.
safety: Stretch connects only to a capture node whose output is forced to zero, then a zero-gain destination route. Speaker/headphone signal is never connected.

measurement.pitch: Positive zero-crossing frequency over captured stationary windows; stereo440/660Hz, later880/1320Hz.
measurement.rate: 4Hz source amplitude modulation; least-squares DC/sine/cosine envelope fit over1.3s, search1..8Hz step.01. Expected4*rate, independent±.15Hz probe tolerance.
measurement.silence: Actual10ms RMS windows below.005, plus RMS/DC/peak. Capture coverage is checked independently.
measurement.onset: First captured256-sample RMS window above.005, scanned in128-sample steps; reported relative to requested output time, no assumed exact onset assertion.
measurement.sourceSuspicion: README documents schedule.output; this version prunes future queue using objIn.outputTime. Future ordering is explicitly probed without vendor changes.
